name: Pad over board cutout
description: A component pad overlapping an internal board void: nothing to solder to, and unsupported copper at the milled edge. Pads only -- a component body over a cutout is often correct (that is what mid-mount means), and a pad inside an opening its own footprint declared is excluded. Requires component pad geometry and an outline with cutouts.
what_it_measures: Count of component pads whose copper extent overlaps an internal cutout (0 when no pad sits over a void).
